The checklist items reference Ethereum Execution Layer (EL) specification functions like `compute_requests_hash`, `encode_account`, `add_to_bloom`, `logs_bloom`, `decode_receipt`, `encode_receipt`, etc. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client.
